subtopics.label: Diabetes Clinical Management and Glycemic Control
subtopics.description: Research on clinical management of type 1 and type 2 diabetes including pharmacotherapy (insulin, GLP-1 agonists, SGLT2 inhibitors, metformin), glycemic monitoring technologies (CGM, wearables), HbA1c outcomes, diabetic ketoacidosis, and diabetes care delivery in diverse populations and settings.

subtopics.label: Diabetic Neuropathy and Corneal Confocal Microscopy
subtopics.description: Studies using corneal confocal microscopy and quantitative sensory testing to diagnose, monitor, and predict diabetic peripheral and autonomic neuropathy, including associations with glycemic control, vitamin D, insulin resistance, and treatment interventions.

subtopics.label: Obesity Treatment: Bariatric Surgery and Endoscopic Procedures
subtopics.description: Research on surgical and endoscopic interventions for obesity including Roux-en-Y gastric bypass, sleeve gastrectomy, duodenal switch, endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty, and intragastric balloons, covering weight loss outcomes, complications, GERD, and metabolic improvements.

subtopics.label: Obesity Pharmacotherapy and Weight Management
subtopics.description: Research on anti-obesity medications including GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists (semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide), first- and second-generation anti-obesity drugs, and medical weight management programs, focusing on efficacy, safety, and long-term weight maintenance.

subtopics.label: Thyroid Disease: Diagnosis, Surgery, and Management
subtopics.description: Research on thyroid nodule evaluation (fine-needle aspiration, molecular testing, TI-RADS), thyroid cancer management (papillary, anaplastic, follicular, medullary), thyroidectomy outcomes, radioactive iodine therapy, and thyroid hormone replacement.

subtopics.label: Adrenal and Parathyroid Disorders
subtopics.description: Research on adrenal disorders including primary hyperaldosteronism, adrenocortical carcinoma, Cushing syndrome, and pheochromocytoma, as well as parathyroid disease including hyperparathyroidism and parathyroid carcinoma, covering surgical management, outcomes, and molecular characterization.

subtopics.label: Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease and Metabolic Liver Conditions
subtopics.description: Research on NAFLD/MASLD pathogenesis, diagnosis, and management including liver fibrosis assessment, steatosis biomarkers, PNPLA3 variants, retinoic acid receptor pathways, alcohol-associated liver disease, and clinical care pathways for metabolic liver disease.

subtopics.label: Adipocyte Biology, Adipogenesis, and Adipose Tissue Function
subtopics.description: Research on molecular mechanisms of adipocyte differentiation, lipid metabolism, thermogenesis, and adipokine signaling, including studies on SIRT1, PGC1α, PPAR pathways, adipose tissue browning, and the role of adipose dysfunction in metabolic disease.

subtopics.label: Pancreatic Beta Cell Function and Insulin Secretion
subtopics.description: Research on pancreatic beta cell biology including insulin secretion mechanisms, beta cell differentiation and failure, ER stress responses, islet vascularization, and molecular targets for restoring beta cell function in type 1 and type 2 diabetes.

subtopics.label: Diabetes and Cardiovascular Complications
subtopics.description: Research on cardiovascular outcomes in diabetes patients including myocardial infarction, heart failure, aortic valve replacement, coronary artery disease, arrhythmias, and the impact of glycemic control on cardiovascular morbidity and mortality.

subtopics.label: Diabetes Epidemiology, Prevention, and Global Burden
subtopics.description: Research on the epidemiology of type 2 diabetes and prediabetes across global populations, mathematical modeling of diabetes burden, prevention programs, community health worker interventions, and population-level risk factor assessment.

subtopics.label: Sphingolipid, Cholesterol, and Lipid Metabolism
subtopics.description: Research on molecular mechanisms of sphingolipid metabolism (ceramide, sphingosine-1-phosphate), cholesterol homeostasis, and lipid signaling in endothelial cells and macrophages, with implications for cardiovascular disease, atherosclerosis, and metabolic dysfunction.

subtopics.label: Sex Hormones, Hypothalamic Regulation, and Reproductive Endocrinology
subtopics.description: Research on estrogen receptor signaling in the hypothalamus and cardiovascular regulation, neuroactive steroids in reproductive mood disorders, gonadal hormone interactions with puberty and behavior, and reproductive endocrinology including AMH, IGF-1, and ovarian function.

subtopics.label: Glucose Transport, NAD+ Metabolism, and Cellular Energy Pathways
subtopics.description: Research on GLUT1/GLUT4 glucose transporter biology, NAD+ biosynthesis and precursors (NMN, NRH), mitochondrial metabolism, and metabolic interventions in glucose transporter deficiency syndromes and obesity-related metabolic dysfunction.

subtopics.label: Diabetes and Cancer Comorbidity Management
subtopics.description: Research on the co-management of diabetes and cancer, including diabetes care disruption after cancer diagnosis, racial disparities in diabetes care among cancer survivors, patient and provider perspectives on managing both conditions, and metabolic syndrome surveillance in cancer survivors.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 and Metabolic Comorbidities
subtopics.description: Research examining the intersection of COVID-19 infection with metabolic conditions including diabetes, obesity, and hyperglycemia, covering disease severity, outcomes, post-acute sequelae, and pathophysiological mechanisms such as adipose tissue infectivity and insulin resistance.

subtopics.label: HIV and Cardiometabolic Complications
subtopics.description: Studies investigating cardiometabolic risk factors, body composition changes, cardiovascular disease, renal function, and metabolic dysregulation in people living with HIV, including effects of antiretroviral therapy and metformin interventions.

subtopics.label: Obesity-Related Comorbidities and Clinical Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on the clinical consequences of obesity across multiple organ systems and life stages, including maternal morbidity, pediatric complications, sleep apnea, pelvic floor disorders, and associations with brain structure and function.

subtopics.label: Wearable Technology and Digital Health for Diabetes Monitoring
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating AI-driven wearable devices, continuous glucose monitoring, and machine learning models for blood glucose prediction, diabetes self-management, and longitudinal monitoring of patients with diabetes.

subtopics.label: Peer Support and Behavioral Interventions for Diabetes Self-Management
subtopics.description: Research on peer-delivered cognitive behavioral therapy, storytelling programs, and community-based interventions designed to improve diabetes self-management, medication adherence, pain outcomes, and psychosocial functioning.

subtopics.label: Cardiovascular Risk Factors, Disparities, and Prevention
subtopics.description: Epidemiological and clinical studies examining cardiovascular disease risk factors, racial and socioeconomic disparities in CVD prevention and treatment, hypertension management, and lipid-lowering therapy across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Diabetic Microvascular Complications and Retinopathy
subtopics.description: Studies on microvascular complications of diabetes including retinopathy, nephropathy, and neuropathy, with emphasis on screening, prevalence in diverse populations, vitamin D associations, and corneal confocal microscopy findings.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiome, Diet, and Host Metabolic Regulation
subtopics.description: Research on how gut microbial communities, dietary patterns, and microbiota-derived metabolites regulate host metabolism, immune function, bile acid signaling, and nutrient homeostasis.

subtopics.label: Metabolic Dysregulation and Alzheimer's Disease
subtopics.description: Studies investigating the metabolic underpinnings of Alzheimer's disease, including brain metabolic alterations, lipidomic profiles, mitochondrial bioenergetics, ketogenic diet effects, and metabolic syndrome biomarkers in cognitive decline.

subtopics.label: Hyperlipidemia Management in Inflammatory Arthritis
subtopics.description: Research on barriers, facilitators, and clinical practices for screening and treating hyperlipidemia and cardiovascular risk in patients with rheumatoid arthritis and other inflammatory joint diseases.

subtopics.label: Metabolic Conditions and Pregnancy Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining the impact of metabolic conditions—including gestational diabetes, obesity, hypertension, and thyroid disorders—on maternal and neonatal outcomes, as well as glucose challenge testing and postpartum cardiovascular risk.

subtopics.label: Obesity, Adiposity, and Brain/Neurological Function
subtopics.description: Research linking body mass index, adiposity, and metabolic factors to brain structure, white matter hyperintensities, hippocampal vasoreactivity, cognitive function, and neurological outcomes.

subtopics.label: Glucagon Receptor Structure and Signaling
subtopics.description: Structural and mechanistic studies of glucagon receptor and related family B GPCR signaling, including cryo-EM characterization, allosteric modulation by RAMPs, and G protein activation mechanisms relevant to metabolic regulation.

subtopics.label: Diabetes Healthcare Utilization, Access, and Quality of Care
subtopics.description: Studies on healthcare utilization patterns, care fragmentation, insurance coverage, Medicaid expansion effects, and quality improvement initiatives for diabetes and related metabolic conditions in diverse healthcare settings.

subtopics.label: FGF23, Vitamin D, and Mineral Homeostasis in Kidney Disease
subtopics.description: Research on fibroblast growth factor 23 (FGF23), vitamin D metabolism, and mineral homeostasis in the context of chronic kidney disease, dietary influences, and renal tubular regulation.
